title: Lament over Judah's Captivity
description: Jeremiah urges the people to give glory to the Lord before darkness falls, and warns that his soul will weep in secret over pride when the Lord's flock is led into captivity. The king and queen mother must sit low when the crown falls, the cities of the Negev are shut up, and all Judah is taken into exile. The people will be scattered like chaff in the desert wind, and their shame will be revealed because of sin, faithlessness, and idolatry.
